==Hero Usage==
* Heroes reserve the use of this spell until an ally has fallen below 70% maximum health, at which point they will use it without regard to the size of incoming damage packets.

== Notes ==
* Just like the concise description says, this spell converts damage to healing, up to the stated maximum. For example, at rank 12 it can negate up to 134 damage (67 damage reduced and 67 damage healed).
* Under Reversal of Fortune, the healing occurs before damage. As such, it is possible for this spell to result in a net loss of health if used on an ally at or near full health.
* This skill, unlike Reversal of Damage, will trigger ''after'' damage reduction like [[Protective Spirit]] and [[Protective Bond]], meaning that you often won't get the full benefit from this skill with other protection in place.
{{anomaly|Contrary to the full description, this skill causes healing and not [[health gain]].}}

== Trivia ==
* The name of this skill may be a reference to the Academy Award-winning 1990 film [[w:Reversal of Fortune|Reversal of Fortune]].
